items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: do you remember this man, uh, Ned? You just call him Ned. Ned?

ctx.x: No, he had played at that place a long time. Yeah. Yeah, that played a long time.
Speaking about those old trumpet players, I wonder, do you remember this man, uh, Ned? You just call him Ned. Ned?

I don't know what his, that's his first name or last name, Ned. Supposed to have been about the time of Buddy Bolden. I don't know, came from uptown I believe, but I don't know. I don't know. Ned. Ned.
